description:
Converge item-kind id patterns on the shared compiled pattern type.

## Background

`ItemKind` keeps `id_pattern_src: String` beside `id_pattern: Regex` (`crates/jit/src/domain/item.rs:643-655`), a private pairing of the compiled-pattern type that rule declarations use.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `ItemKind` holds its id pattern as an `IdPattern`, and the separate source field is gone.
- [hard] REQ-02: An invalid item-kind id pattern fails configuration loading with an error naming the kind.
title: Item kinds hold their id pattern as IdPattern
